text:
nora (pm): Starting a short thread for a cost-aware, SLA-gated rollout pattern. Want a playbook that balances token budgets, per-tenant SLAs, and automated explainable diverts (so CS can tell customers why). Ideas below, please thumbs.

nora (pm): Phases:
1) internal mirror 1h + synthetic probes;
2) opt-in micro: 10 tenants, 0.5% global, per-tenant token_budget=50k, A/B 1:1, 4h bake;
3) graded widen: increase tenants & budget by cohort if pass gates;
4) regional ramp only after 24h stable and cost delta < 15%.

vit (eng): Implementation notes: flags need fields: token_budget, sla_tier, explain_mode (on/off) and reason_code enum. Controller enforces per-tenant budget and emits human-readable stop reasons. Add dry_warm to prefill caches without billing.

samir (sre): Circuit breaker rules: auto-divert tenant if any:
- p95 > 2x baseline for 5m OR
- error rate > +0.4% sustained 10m OR
- token burn > budget by 10% in 30m.
Region divert requires 3 tenants in 20m. When auto-divert runs, flag state = "auto_divert:<reason>" and page SRE. Manual unblock only. Add 30m cooldown.

anya (data): For explainable diverts: we'll produce a short diagnostic bundle per divert: (1) delta p95, (2) sample embedding cosine drop, (3) cost_delta %, (4) stratum hit (prompt_length/tenant_size). Use Bayesian sequential checks; require min 500 impressions for a divert decision unless infra signals hit.

claire (cs): CS needs the reason_code surfaced in tenant console and a short human-friendly sentence. Example mapping: latency_spike -> "We routed you off the experimental path due to higher latency; our team is investigating." Also add auto-email template with the diagnostics link.

vit (eng): Flag example (stringified for infra): {"name":"prod.ff.routing.costaware.lowbit","default":"false","allowed_tenants":"[\"acct_77\"]","token_budget":"50000","sla_tier":"gold","explain_mode":"true","dry_warm":"true","owner":"nora"}

samir (sre): Warmup: 15 rps/tenant with exponential backoff; KV cache prefill path should be rate-limited and flagged as non-billing. Also require a system-wide emergency throttle when GPU mem > 70%.

anya (data): Reporting: 6h quick-check + 24h detailed. Each auto-divert writes a compact record to the rollout audit log with the diagnostic bundle and reason_code. We'll add a panel that ranks divert causes across tenants.

claire (cs): Add a consent flow checkbox for "show diagnostics on divert" and a toggle to prefer manual un-divert. We'll draft copy and templates.

flag-bot: Created flag prod.ff.routing.costaware.lowbit in staging at 2140009999.

nora (pm): Actions: vit - flag + controller + dry_warm (ETA Thu); anya - divert diagnostics + dashboard (ETA Wed); samir - circuit breaker + warmup throttle (ETA Fri); claire - CS copy + consent (ETA Mon). If no objections I'll schedule mirror for next Tue. Ack here.
